I've felt on edge on several days, and had worrying I couldn't control on several days. No panic attacks.
Work is mildly affected, I see friends a bit less than usual, my energy is about 5 out of 10, and I'm still keeping up with self-care.
Mainly I want to handle work pressure better and sleep a bit more. Some practical strategies for managing stress would really help.
